targetConstraints.schema: is_show/is_verify smallint no 0/1 CHECK observed; refusal varchar255; auto_on_time int32. No new DDL necessary.
targetConstraints.lockProtocol: BargainSourceProductLifecycle: every visibility/review writer takes exclusive lifecycle namespace731634 before product/cart/SKU locks; shared admission on starts/help. ProductAssociation namespace731617 is distinct and also required for editing coordination. Checkout owns carts before final product write, so NOWAIT on all target product/cart/SKU rows avoids reverse wait cycles. Real table barrier may be required for SKU/cart phantoms; tradeoff must be stated.
targetConstraints.scopeSeparation: Existing generic editor, mobile setShow, recycle toggle/permanent purge, actual card inventory and providers are separate. Do not call modern existing write an implementation of these four absent old review endpoints.
